rule: Requests regarding Zoom accounts, Zoom webinars, and Panopto lecture recordings should be routed to lms-canvas.
Issues with VPN access, eduroam wifi, desk phones, network drops, and globalprotect routing should be routed to telecom-network.
Student enrollment discrepancies between Banner and Canvas should be routed to registrar-systems.
Device registration for gaming consoles, Chromecasts, and residence hall network issues in buildings like Aspen or Cedar Commons should be routed to resnet.
High-performance computing cluster accounts, slurm jobs, and research storage quotas should be routed to research-computing.
Classroom projector, podium PC, and lecture capture hardware issues in specific room numbers should be routed to classroom-av.
Issues with multi-factor authentication, Duo push failures, password resets, and account lockouts should be routed to identity-access.
FAFSA codes, financial aid disbursements, and eBill authorized payer errors should be routed to financial-aid-systems.
Suspicious emails regarding aid hubs or account verifications should be routed to security-phishing.
Requests for assistive software like Read&Write, ZoomText, JAWS, or live captioning (CART) should be routed to accessibility-tech.
Pharos printing fees, print charges, and printer jams in student unions or labs should be routed to print-services.
Software installations in specific East zone buildings like Okafor should be routed to lab-desktop-east.
Operating system updates and software issues affecting lab PCs in West zone buildings like Ridgeway should be routed to lab-desktop-west.
